trends.name: Iran Military Threat Escalation
trends.summary: Despite US-Israeli strikes, 50% of Iran's missile launchers and thousands of attack drones remain operational, with Iranian Revolutionary Guard threatening attacks on US tech companies. This geopolitical risk is pressuring energy markets, mortgage rates, and creating uncertainty for tech sector valuations including NVDA and AAPL.

trends.name: Hormuz Strait Reopening Collapse
trends.summary: Prediction markets show odds of Strait of Hormuz normalization before June 1 have plummeted to ~30%, down sharply from recent highs, signaling sustained energy supply concerns. This directly contradicts earlier Easter-optimism headlines and signals prolonged crude volatility ahead.

trends.name: Energy Prices Surge & Inflation Headwinds
trends.summary: Higher energy costs from Middle East conflict are hitting both inflation and disposable income simultaneously. Fed's Williams acknowledged war is already showing in gasoline prices; mortgage rates have risen 5 weeks straight, impacting housing and consumer purchasing power.

trends.name: Private Credit Fund Redemption Rush
trends.summary: Massive inflow of investor redemption requests from private-credit funds is accelerating, threatening Wall Street's recently crowned 'kings.' Fed's Williams monitoring closely but doesn't see systemic risk yet—however, prolonged pressure on liquidity and pricing could cascade.

trends.name: Labor Market Deterioration Signals
trends.summary: Forward-looking data shows sharp deterioration: job availability vs. scarcity gap fell to 5.8 points (lowest since 2020 pandemic), with only 27.3% of consumers seeing plentiful jobs. Fed expects 'low hire, low fire' stability, but unemployment pressure is building.

trends.name: Trump Admin Political & Tariff Volatility
trends.summary: Trump fires Attorney General Pam Bondi amid ongoing insider trading probes; administration sets 100% tariffs on imported drugs (with exemptions). Combined with global investor skepticism on American exceptionalism, policy uncertainty is elevated—Pam Bondi's 'Dow 50,000' comment now appears disconnected from current market reality.

trends.name: AI Sector Earnings & Revenue Reality Check
trends.summary: Microsoft touts Copilot sales traction, but AI anxiety weighs on broader equity markets. Sentiment shows investors remain skeptical on AI monetization despite vendor claims—valuation pressure continues despite operational progress.

trends.name: Tesla Delivery Collapse & EV Demand Shift
trends.summary: Tesla stock suffers steepest 2026 drop after disappointing delivery report, with evidence the company is 'actively sacrificing' EV sales volumes. This signals demand weakness and potential margin pressure in the critical EV sector.

trends.name: Supabase Unicorn Valuation Round
trends.summary: Database startup Supabase in talks to double valuation to $10 billion while securing ~$500 million in funding. Reflects continued venture capital appetite for infrastructure/API plays despite broader tech caution.

trends.name: Commodity Sector Mixed Signals & Reratings
trends.summary: Gold faces hurdles but long-term bull case intact per UBS; mining stocks showing mixed narratives—Eldorado Gold offers value, Lynas Rare Earths downgraded as price floors priced in. Energy Fuels upgraded to Buy on story change, while Ecopetrol rerating story is exhausted.

trends.name: Airline & Consumer Discretionary Cost Inflation
trends.summary: United Airlines hikes checked bag fees by $10 amid fuel cost pressures; Sam's Club raises membership fees with Costco and BJ's potentially next. Rising operational costs are flowing through to consumers, pressuring discretionary spending.

trends.name: Healthcare & Medicare Advantage Market Access Crisis
trends.summary: Hospitals increasingly refusing to accept Medicare Advantage for cancer patients—described as 'overlooked catastrophe.' This signals deepening tensions between payers, providers, and beneficiaries; market consolidation risks and regulatory scrutiny likely to follow.
